title: Claude.ai routine definition
description: Declarative spec for one scheduled claude.ai remote agent (routine). Resolution of `environment` and `mcp_connectors` names to claude.ai IDs happens at sync time via the /update-claude-routines skill — UUIDs and URLs do not appear in this file.

name.description: Human-readable routine name. Used as the lookup key when reconciling — must be unique across the user's claude.ai routines.

cron.description: 5-field cron expression in UTC. Minimum interval is 1 hour; sub-hourly expressions are rejected by the API.

run_once_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp. Must be in the future at sync time; past timestamps are rejected by the API.

enabled.description: Whether the routine fires on schedule. Default true.

model.description: Claude model ID. Prefer pinned snapshots (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) for autonomous routines so behavior doesn't shift under you. Family aliases (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5) auto-track the latest snapshot.

environment.description: Claude.ai environment NAME. Resolved to env_id at sync time. Pattern-rejection of UUID-shaped values via enum.

sources.description: Git repositories cloned into the routine's workspace. Optional.

allowed_tools.description: Local-tool allowlist. NOTE: the claude.ai API silently overrides an empty list with preset:default, so this field is not actually restrictive. Rely on prompt-level constraints if you need a narrow tool surface.

items.description: Short connector name from the user's claude.ai account. Must match [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ (the same constraint the API places on mcp_connections.name). Resolved to {connector_uuid, name, url} at sync time.

mcp_connectors.description: MCP connectors to attach to the routine, referenced by short name. Resolution table lives in the /update-claude-routines skill.

prompt.description: The user-message content the routine fires with. Self-contained — the agent starts with zero context from prior sessions.
